source: Final visible browser assertions through accessibility snapshots

checks.name: All non-table/form catalog entries mount with unique IDs and declared applicable states
All configured family variants mount without mutating caller data
Every non-table/form default and configured variant fits a 320px host
Button async work locks duplicate clicks, surfaces failure, and supports retry
Button cancellation and unmount ignore late responses
Links reject executable/protocol-relative schemes and expose external destinations
Checkable/removable tags retain disabled tags and return real IDs
Badges retain zero, cap counts and expose dot meaning
Avatar image failure falls back to initials and group overflow opens all names
Descriptions retain zero/false/null and divider exposes orientation
Cards collapse without losing content and configured actions return IDs
Statistics format precision and preserve unknown values
Progress supports bounded values, segments, unknown duration and live updates
Tabs skip disabled items, preserve panels, close dirty tabs only after confirmation
Tabs add requests do not fabricate items; caller can replace the tab configuration
Navigation expands independently of selection and inherits disabled ancestors
Navigation keyboard skips disabled entries and breadcrumb sibling menus return IDs
Collapse accordion permits one section, retains disabled items, and supports keyboard
List search, sorting, load-more and disabled item actions use actual configured records
Remote list append keeps rows on failure, retries from same cursor and ignores stale results
Calendar month/week/day/agenda share events; disabled dates and keyboard obey restrictions
Calendar navigation handles month/year boundaries and readonly selection
Notification filters, toggle, mark-all and dismissal respect disabled records
Gallery supports next/previous, bounded zoom, rotate/reset, error retry and Escape
Menus support checkbox/radio/submenu/back and disabled items without executing dangerous actions
Popover closes on outside focus, Escape, and explicit close with focus return
Dialog async confirm stays open on failure, prevents duplicate and closes after success
Dialog cancel aborts pending handler; backdrop and Escape can be explicitly locked
Drawer placements are configurable and every close returns focus to trigger
Confirm cancellation never invokes business handler
Alert closes and result pages emit configured next actions only
Toast supports manual dismissal and unmount cleans pending timers
Skeleton supports static structure and overlay loading prevents underlying interaction
Carousel respects boundaries, loops, indicators, keyboard and explicit pause
Splitter keyboard clamps limits and pointer dragging updates proportional state
Backtop appears at threshold and returns only its own scroll container to top
Shared loading/error/forbidden states hide data, retry through loader and recover
Readonly select, tree-select and people controls cannot open or remove selected items
Disabled selected people and disabled tree ancestors remain protected
Standalone input and search do not commit Chinese composition before completion
AI chat stop cancels streaming, preserves question and locks conversation switching while running
Workspace slots keep content identity and status per generated result
Process running state locks expansion and state buttons preserve disclosure content
Pagination supports full/simple modes, capacity changes, bounds, total replacement and disabled state
Tooltip is focus/hover accessible, Escape closes, and placements remain inside viewport
Configurable shell retains the active section while folding and protects disabled routes
Course cards use supplied metadata and only update local favorite state
Agent and task preparation return supplied IDs/text without starting AI work
Messages render actual Markdown and feedback toggles mutually exclusively with reason capture
Citations display supplied verification status and results return their actual object IDs
Approval requires a rejection reason and only advances after confirmed business response
Custom public processing stages escape content and running state cannot collapse
Remounting and destroying interactive layers remove popups and generated dialogs
